payload.title: Five sentences in docs/aria/CONTRACTS.md, aria_kernel/finding.py and aria_kernel/plan_origin.py still name the frozen genesis file docs/reviews/_registry/findings.jsonl as the registry the gate, report_ingestion and the deadline source read, and the stale-reference spec does not scan those paths.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_origin.py:86-91 (says registry-form ids are resolved by the gate through findings.jsonl; false for every finding born after the freeze)
docs/aria/CONTRACTS.md:250-251 (says report_ingestion_scan reads findings.jsonl; it runs the projection CLI over genesis and event logs)
docs/aria/CONTRACTS.md:1589-1592 (says the review-file binding lives in the checkout's findings.jsonl)
docs/aria/CONTRACTS.md:1999 (names findings.jsonl as the source of the registry_finding deadline surface; deadlines.py reads the projection)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding.py:146-149 (names findings.jsonl as the registry report_ingestion reads)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/report_ingestion.py:63-77 (the actual reader: finding-registry project over the frozen segment and every event log)
payload.rule_violated: Docs must name the real owner: after the MF-2 freeze the registry is the genesis segment plus per-finding event logs read through finding-registry project, and findings.jsonl alone holds none of the findings registered since (ARIA-HIGH-983 appears in zero lines of it).
payload.notes: A reader or agent that follows these sentences reads or expects the frozen 3271-entry file and concludes that a post-freeze finding does not exist or has no review-file binding. The kernel code is right, so this is a documentation and comment fault; it will recur because the pin that exists for the same class does not cover docs/aria or aria-kernel. Close condition: Reword the five sentences to name the projection, the genesis segment and the event logs, and extend the stale-reference spec's scan roots to docs/aria and aria-kernel/aria_kernel with the same frozen-or-genesis rule; the spec then fails if a line there names docs/reviews/_registry/findings.jsonl without qualification. Plan row: MF-2 (registry event store). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
